rows.en: Heh, you got lucky.
Looks like you made it out safe, too.
Not a bad result.
I trained you! This much is only natural!
Oh, you're shaping up nicely!
rows.notes: Whisper wrote ii renmei; probably ii rendo (training level) or renkei (teamwork).

rows.en: Hmph, you've finally learned to fly, rookie.
You're starting to look like me, you son of a gun.
All right! Tonight we drink till we pass out! That's an order!
I'm a lucky guy, having such a skilled partner.
Hey! Don't zip around and get lost!
Don't chicken out and run!
Come on, quit dawdling! Let's go!
Think you can keep up with me?
Listen! Don't do anything reckless!
You handle support!
Well, I've got to escort you properly.
Don't make me worry!
I'm expecting a lot from you.
One thing I'll say: don't die!
Be careful! If you die, I can't hit on you!
A sortie with you, huh? Not bad.
It's a miracle you even came back.
Geez! You gave me a scare!
rows.notes: Whisper wrote sebayakasete; probably sawagasete (made a fuss/worried me).

rows.en: Ha! I can't even call you a rookie yet!
Were you okay over there?
All right! Heading back!
When did you get this good?!
I'm counting on you from now on, too!
You're about ready to graduate from rookie.
You've gotten a lot better, too.
Damn, you've become dependable before I knew it.
You've turned into a fine woman. I might get serious!
Hikaru! I'm not losing to you yet!
Hmph! You've gotten better!
Ah ha ha ha! Still a rookie!
Don't underestimate Skull Leader!
You've gotten good, rookie. Or should I say, you're not one anymore.
I, a guide of the wind... why must I do such a thing...
So you're saying calamity is almost upon us.
The wind rises. A terrible wind, carrying the Kadun that brings ruin.
rows.notes: Kadun heard as katakana kadun; spelled per glossary.

rows.en: God of the wind, please protect that person.
Protecting you from Kadun is also my duty.
I can't let the song of ruin echo through the world.
To think I'd have to rely on the power of iron pollen.
rows.notes: Whisper: tetsu no kafun (iron pollen); Zero lore term, not in glossary, kept literal.

rows.en: Release your power now.
You should be able to overcome the cursed pollen.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote noroi no katon (fire release); read as noroi no kafun (cursed pollen).

rows.en: So you're cursed by Kadun, the bringer of ruin.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote karuun; read as Kadun (Zero's curse), as in the neighbouring clips.

rows.en: Ah, the iron pollen...
rows.notes: Whisper wrote hanadon (flower bowl); read as kafun (pollen).

rows.en: It's because you relied on iron pollen and fire pollen.
AFOS... Bird Human.
rows.notes: Whisper: eifosu; AFOS relic and Bird Human, relation unclear.

rows.en: Another life...
No... how could you...
So this too is the wind's guidance.
Could it be... a Bird Human?
You walked into the fighting yourself.
I only fulfilled my duty as the wind's guide.
Looks like you overcame the pollen of calamity.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote wazawai no kadan (calamitous flower group); read as kafun (pollen).

rows.en: The restless wind has calmed. The wind of ruin seems to have passed.
I offer you the song of the sacred cycle.
May a good wind blow for you.
Grant strength to that one.
Yes.
Understood.
As the wind guides me.
Like that, the cursed pollen will possess you.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote noroi no kadan; read as kafun (pollen).

rows.en: The tune of the wind is dangerous, isn't it.
Kadun seems to have possessed you.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote karuun; read as Kadun.

rows.en: The wind of ruin!
As I thought, you couldn't beat the pollen of calamity.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote wazawai no kagun; read as kafun (pollen).

rows.en: So this is the end of a blood-stained warrior.
You're always fighting, aren't you?
Are you... a Bird Human?
Shin... you helped me.
The song of ruin...
rows.notes: Whisper wrote uta (poem); probably the song of ruin.

rows.en: If you're done, leave quickly.
If you outsiders hadn't brought your tools of war...
rows.notes: Whisper wrote kagu (furniture); read as dogu (tool).

rows.en: Shall I put the curse of Kadun on you?
Looks like you escaped Kadun.
Looks like you stopped the song of ruin.
I don't want the Mayan people put in danger.
